tagline: Framework de orquestração de agentes autônomos role-playing, por cooperação (Crew = time com papéis + tasks).

modules.name: crewai
modules.description: Core package — Agent, Crew, Task, Process, Flow

modules.name: memory
modules.description: Short-term, long-term, entity, user memory + storage

modules.name: flow
modules.description: Flow — graph-based orchestration com visualizer HTML

external_dependencies_top10.purpose: Leitura de PDF para knowledge sources

entry_points.command: from crewai import Crew, Agent, Task

capabilities.name: Role-playing agents with goal+backstory
capabilities.description: Cada Agent tem role, goal, backstory, tools — persona injetada no system prompt

capabilities.name: Crew orchestration (sequential & hierarchical)
capabilities.description: Process.sequential e Process.hierarchical como topologias fixas

capabilities.name: Task graph with dependencies
capabilities.description: Tasks com context, expected_output, callbacks e ConditionalTask

capabilities.name: Flow (graph-based workflow)
capabilities.description: DSL decorators @start/@listen/@router para grafos de eventos + visualizer HTML

capabilities.name: Multi-tier memory (short/long/entity/user)
capabilities.description: 4 níveis de memória com backend Chroma/SQLite

capabilities.name: LiteLLM multi-provider
capabilities.description: Suporte a OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Groq, etc. via litellm

capabilities.name: Task guardrails
capabilities.description: Guardrails validam output antes de passar ao próximo task (v0.86)

capabilities.name: Planner handler
capabilities.description: Planning automático que decompõe tasks antes da execução

capabilities.name: Task output storage + training
capabilities.description: Persistência de outputs e modo training para aprimorar agentes

unique_selling_points: Modelo mental de 'crew' (time com papéis) — abstração role-playing natural
Sequential + hierarchical + Flow (grafo) cobre múltiplas topologias
CLI para scaffolding de projetos novos

limitations.description: Paralelismo limitado pelo GIL Python — fan-out verdadeiro requer async manual
Sem UI de monitoramento oficial — depende de OTel backend externo
Failure recovery rudimentar — sem DLQ/replay determinístico embutido
